alerts.text: No round has started since yesterday's report, so nothing new was applied to teams/team2/team.json (24 Nov Variation A stays). R15 trades lock Thursday 3 Dec 19:30 Athens.

Kamenjas hurt his knee in R14 (helped off before half-time, came back, 15' and 5 PIR), and new signing Perrin had 20 PIR in his debut. I cut his expected PIR from 17 to 14.5 and took the armband off him: Vezenkov is captain in all three variations.
Prices are still R14's (the site's R15 price page isn't out). All variations keep 0.8+ in the bank; re-import app prices once the game updates.
Team 2 has no per-game rule, so A stacks four Olympiacos players plus Bartzokas: the biggest single-game risk on either team. B keeps three.

FIBA window: Vezenkov (Bulgaria v Denmark, 26 Nov), Procida (Italy, 29 Nov in Belgrade), Kamenjas (Bosnia, 26 and 29 Nov, after the knee knock). Hifi withdrew from France's squad to rest. The daily runs will re-check before Thursday.
R14 miss: Robinson captain 5 PIR, Navarro (RED) −20, Carter 0, Koloko 6. Olympiacos and Madrid won big: that's where R15 goes.

rumours.text: Olympiacos are chasing Shaquielle McKissic to replace Konchar, but need an agreement with Türk Telekom first. Bartzokas has 'no timeline' for Dorsey, who is with Greece for the window.
rumours.impact: Fournier and Cory Joseph keep big minutes for R15. McKissic would mainly cut Ward's minutes. Bartzokas (OLY) is the R15 coach pick either way.

rumours.text: Campazzo (hamstring) is 'expected' back for the Clásico on 3 Dec; he was at practice on 24 Nov but couldn't take part, and is out of Argentina's window.
rumours.impact: If he plays, Maledon's and Feliz's minutes drop a little (B's risk); Abalde and Tavares are unaffected.

rumours.text: Kamenjas took a knee knock against Efes and was helped off, but returned; Perrin debuted with 11 pts, 12 reb, 20 PIR. Faried is still out.
rumours.impact: Kamenjas' minutes ceiling drops from 30' to ~25'; not a captain this round.

rumours.text: Milano signed centre Ze'Rik Onyema on 25 Nov with Booker and Peters (psoas, two weeks) out.
rumours.impact: Diop's 10' don't grow; he's only a cheap Thursday starter to sub out.

rumours.text: Navarro blamed fatigue ('maybe we shouldn't have practiced') for the 84–108 loss; the Serbian federation hit back at his comments on resting national-team players.
rumours.impact: Rotation unpredictable: Carter's minutes swing week to week. Navarro (RED) at Fenerbahçe is a coach to avoid.

rumours.text: Vildoza (ankle), Stevens (calf, 4–6 weeks), Thompson and Willis all missed R14 at Dubai.
rumours.impact: Marinkovic and Franks keep their minutes; Marinkovic's 11.7' in R14 were foul trouble.

rumours.text: Nebo out 3–4 months (patellar tendon), Punter until late December; Killian Hayes signed, Gibson may return around R15.
rumours.impact: Helps Madrid's bigs and guards in the Clásico; Robinson's load eases once Hayes plays.

review: R14 (scorecard): Variation A scored 54.8 against 176 predicted (B 78.5, C 71.5), counted on the pre-round lineup. Captain Robinson 5 against the best option Vezenkov 23: the captain miss alone cost ~36 points. Zvezda (Carter 0, Koloko 6, Navarro −20) did the rest: three players and the coach from one team in a slump. Lessons: the default captain is the Olympiacos home star until a better case appears, and no coach on a team in a slump. Projections: stars were 3.3 PIR under projection and the upside misses were role jumps (Cory Joseph 31 vs 7.8, Grigonis 26 vs 8.9), so Joseph is in all three plans. Research: 80 searches, 40 pages read, 6 players unverified (Ward, Robinson, Frisch, Diarra, Sleva domestic lines; Koloko's national-team status).
